name: Taiwan Green Environment Technology Inc.
summary: Taiwan Green Environment Technology Inc. specializes in the management of water resources and the processing of waste materials. The company offers a complete range of services for purified water treatment projects, encompassing initial planning, design, construction, installation, ongoing maintenance, and operational management. Furthermore, it supplies essential equipment and chemical products required for these systems. In the waste sector, the company delivers comprehensive treatment and recycling solutions, which include project conceptualization, facility development, and the distribution of relevant processing equipment. It also undertakes the construction of biomass power generation systems. Beyond its core environmental endeavors, Taiwan Green Environment Technology Inc. diversifies its operations into the electronic components business and the distribution of everyday consumer goods. Its product offerings additionally feature continuous water supply construction and operational systems, specialized screening buckets, and stainless steel corrugated tubing. Established in 1989, the company maintains its headquarters in Taipei City, Taiwan.
